impact: The first big neocloud print of the week sets the tone for NBIS, which reports Nov 12 premarket with options pricing about a 17% move. Financing costs and backlog conversion are the swing factors.
summary: CoreWeave reports Q3 after the bell on Nov 10 (call 5pm ET). Consensus is about $3.54B revenue, up roughly 159% y/y, against company guidance of $3.45B to $3.6B. Interest expense is guided at $860M to $940M; backlog was $104.2B at end of Q2.
title: CoreWeave reports Q3 Tuesday after close, $3.54B expected
